text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap achieved splendid results
in the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through those
truly precious "first three years"—

And so, one day while still basking in the afterglow
of that major milestone.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please wait just a little longer.
It will be ready soon.

Oguri Cap called me out to the riverbank.
At the place where we often trained, she...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm making it strictly according to the recipe
everyone back home taught me.
It has to be delicious!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's because...
I wanted to express my gratitude to you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Training alongside you
has truly helped me grow."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Everyone back home is so happy for me, too.
So... my dream came true.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer.
For running alongside me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And going forward...
let's keep running together.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...It should be just about ready.
Go ahead, dig in."
